# Stockfish 18 (lite, single-threaded) for the browser

Used by Play Blindfold on /resources/blindfold/. Loaded only when a student starts a game against Stockfish.

- Engine: [Stockfish](https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish), compiled to WebAssembly by [Stockfish.js](https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js) (npm package `stockfish@18.0.8`).
- License: GPL-3.0 (see COPYING.txt). Source code: https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js and https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish
- Files are unmodified copies of `bin/stockfish-18-lite-single.js` and `.wasm` from the npm package.
